status: code hardening and Release checks complete; hosted CI, sanitizer and final operating checks pending
fixes: UGC copy/reset/migration prepare a full temporary file before publishing; no-overwrite copies publish without a check-then-overwrite race.
UGC save/open/verification writes working and saved copies through the existing rollback-capable compound writer. Malformed work is parsed before replacing working data.
Invalid saved-work paths are rejected. Directory iteration returns a failure instead of throwing or accepting an incomplete list.
Work browser displays verification/open errors; recovery backup paths remain available in the error information.
GameRenderTargets shares allocation/deallocation, cannot be copied, releases owned resources, checks dimensions and restores GL bindings/unpack state.
NPC Inspector rejects missing Game/Stage; placement checks Game before use and removes a dead initialization.
Game::Shutdown documentation now agrees with its destructor call.
CTest launches nine independent runtime suites; a failed suite does not stop unrelated suites. An isolated interactive entry runs the actual Game::RunLoop without user saves.

design_audit.method: all-source structural scan and compiler analysis, plus focused manual tracing of orchestration, save/undo/reload, ownership and render-resource boundaries; not a claim of line-by-line manual reading of every file
focused_boundaries: PhysicsWorldBuilder and PhysicsSystem Bullet removal/destruction order
PlatformAdhesionComponent teardown and cleared Player registries
MeshLoadSystem, GameFrameRenderer and GPU shutdown before GameWindow
retained_choices: Game remains the composition/orchestration facade; replacing every shared service access with callbacks would add unrelated complexity.
Straight UI control sequences and schema field mappings remain in order; size alone does not justify splitting them.
Small local normalization/interpolation helpers and mutable/const lookup pairs remain local; no generic base class is introduced to eliminate a few repeated lines.
Platform switch state/visual logic remains in its component; only actual common contact detection is shared.
